Hero.title: The <important>AI with no limits</important>. No filters, no censorship, no excuses.
Hero.description: Brujo IA gives you private access to uncensored AI models to write, create images and explore any idea, without a corporate filter deciding what you can ask. Pay with PayPhone in seconds.

UseCases.section_title: An AI for what the others won't dare
UseCases.section_description: Real use ideas. Ask for anything, as explicit or daring as you need: Brujo answers without judging.
UseCases.couples_description: Spicy texts, love letters, games and personalised fantasies to surprise your partner. Fantasy images starring the two of you.
UseCases.couples_example: “Write my girlfriend a daring message for tonight, in our inside-joke style…”
UseCases.creators_description: Scripts, captions, set ideas and artwork for OnlyFans, Fansly or Telegram. Unfiltered images for covers and promos.
UseCases.creators_example: “Give me 10 provocative captions for today's post and a boudoir-style cover image.”
UseCases.friends_description: Roasts, pranks, custom memes, bachelor/bachelorette parties and politically incorrect jokes for the group chat.
UseCases.friends_example: “Write a brutal roast of my friend Carlos, who's always late and brags about his bike.”
UseCases.roleplay_description: Immersive conversations with characters that remember context and never break role. Virtual girlfriend/boyfriend, adventures or interactive stories.
UseCases.roleplay_example: “You're a mysterious vampire in a Quito bar and I just walked in…”
UseCases.writers_description: Romance, erotica, horror or thrillers with no refusals. Explicit scenes, real villains and raw dialogue when the story calls for it.
UseCases.writers_example: “Continue chapter 3: the reunion scene, intense and uncensored.”
UseCases.marketing_description: Aggressive copy, ads for sex shops, bars, tobacco or betting, and content other AIs refuse to write.
UseCases.marketing_example: “Write 5 Instagram ads for my sex shop with humour and double meaning.”

HowItWorks.section_description: No international cards, no setup. Sign up, pay with PayPhone and start generating.
HowItWorks.step1_description: Sign up with your email or Google. It's free and takes 30 seconds.
HowItWorks.step2_description: Click “Pay with PayPhone” in the dashboard, pay $19 from your app and come back. Your plan is active instantly for 30 days.
HowItWorks.step3_description: In the dashboard choose the Text tab to write or the Image tab to generate high-resolution art.
HowItWorks.step4_description: Describe what you want in detail and hit Generate. Your monthly usage shows in the dashboard bars.
HowItWorks.tip1: Be specific: mention tone, length, characters and context (“short message, playful tone, for my wife”).
HowItWorks.tip2: For images describe style, lighting and framing (“realistic photo, warm light, close-up”).
HowItWorks.tip3: Not convinced? Ask for concrete changes in a new prompt: “more explicit”, “shorter”, “in verse”.
HowItWorks.tip4: Your plan includes 500 images and 2 million text tokens per month: enough for heavy daily use.

Features.section_title: Everything an AI should let you do
Features.section_description: Powered by Venice.ai's private, uncensored models. Your prompts are not stored or used for training.
Features.feature1_description: Write stories, scripts, copy or code without refusals or moralizing. The model answers what you ask.
Features.feature2_description: Generate high-resolution images from any prompt, with no watermark and no content filter.
Features.feature3_description: Your prompts and results are processed privately and never used to train models.
Features.feature4_description: No international cards required. Pay in USD with PayPhone, the local payment gateway.
Features.feature5_description: Your PRO plan activates the moment PayPhone confirms the payment. No waiting.
Features.feature6_description: One payment, 30 days of PRO. Renew whenever you want, nothing charges automatically.
